##### Project general facts

Nova Tower by Al Ansari Properties is a residential tower where heritage inspiration meets modern living, shaped by a family legacy of quality and trust. The building rises above a basement, a ground floor and a two-level parking podium to a rooftop, and offers one- and two-bedroom apartments complemented by retail units at ground level. Thoughtfully designed for families and professionals at every stage of life, the tower brings comfort, community and sophistication together in a calm, well-planned setting.

Amenities are designed around renewal, wellbeing and an active lifestyle. A tranquil zen garden offers a peaceful retreat, while the swimming pool with its pool deck and shaded cabanas creates an inviting space for relaxing and sunbathing. Residents can stay active in the fully equipped gym, on the padel court or on the yoga deck. A barbecue area provides a relaxed outdoor setting for gatherings with family, friends and neighbours.

Apartments feature generous ceiling heights, practical layouts and private balconies that extend living spaces outdoors. Homes are delivered fully furnished with tasteful, modern interiors, ready for residents to move in. Kitchens are fitted with high-quality cabinetry and built-in appliances that combine functionality with sleek design. Premium materials, refined finishes and carefully selected fittings complete each residence, creating a sophisticated and comfortable living environment.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Science Park is a dedicated business and residential district in Al Barsha South, built to support innovation in the science, healthcare, energy and environmental sectors. It hosts a large community of companies alongside modern laboratories, offices and residential buildings, with green spaces and pedestrian-friendly areas that create a calm, balanced setting for working and living close together. Its mix of research facilities and homes appeals to residents who want to live near their workplace.

Al Khail Road provides quick connections to Burj Khalifa, Dubai Hills Mall and Burj Al Arab, while Dubai Miracle Garden and Global Village are a short drive away. Neighbouring communities such as Arjan, Al Barsha South and Jumeirah Village Circle add schools, clinics, supermarkets and shopping centres within easy reach of residents. Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates and Downtown Dubai are also accessible via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, while parks and walking paths in the district encourage an active outdoor routine.

Dubai Science Park attracts professionals working in the district and across the city, supporting steady rental demand for well-located apartments. Its central position between the main business corridors and family-oriented communities makes it appealing to both end users and investors. Steady commercial activity and modern infrastructure strengthen the area's long-term appeal, while competitive entry points compared with more central districts attract first-time buyers and young families.
